title: C#: System.ArgumentException: Disposable not registered. (Parameter 'weakReference')
body:
### Tested versions

- 4.7.2.stable.mono

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable.mono - macOS 15.3 (Darwin 25.3.0, arm64, RELEASE_ARM64_T8122) - .NET 9.0.19 (osx-arm64)

### Issue description

The following error was thrown in a release build of my game, which causes a SIGABRT to follow:
 
```
System.ArgumentException: Disposable not registered. (Parameter 'weakReference')
  at void DisposablesTracker.UnregisterDisposable(WeakReference<IDisposable> weakReference)() in DisposablesTracker.cs:line 91
  at void Disposer.Dispose(bool disposing)() in Variant.cs:line 47
  at void Disposer.Finalize()() in Variant.cs:line 32
  at uint GC.RunFinalizers()() in GC.CoreCLR.cs:line 317
```

### Steps to reproduce

While I am unsure why this happened exactly (I am working off a Sentry log), you can reproduce by calling "Dispose" on `Variant`s with the same `Disposer`

```cs
Variant variant = "test";
var copy = variant;
variant.Dispose();
copy.Dispose();   // ArgumentException: Disposable not registered.
```

Note that the reported crash involves no double-dispose in user code. The stack trace provided above shows the second call arriving from `~Disposer()` on the finalizer thread, where the exception is unhandleable and terminates the process. The snippet I supplied above is only to show that `Disposer.Dispose(bool)` throws when entered twice (non-idempotent).



### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A, the snippet above is sufficient to reproduce.
